verdict.rationale: Vendor copy says you can call the assistant and that it may proactively call you, and the privacy policy confirms optional audio/voice features. That supports a phone-based voice channel. Community reports only cover Instinct placing calls to third parties (restaurants, dentists) on the user's behalf, with requests made over iMessage, not users talking to it by voice. Missing for 10: any hands-on evidence of a user voice-conversing with the assistant, and evidence of real-time, low-latency, natural turn-taking.
